## D — Accuracy and source controls for Sharing the road and work zones
The sharing the road and work zones facts are authored from the selected official physical pages and preserve the actor, triggering condition and exceptions described there.
Source confidence is high for page fidelity; current legal applicability is limited by the old edition and recorded freshness debt.
Image-only information has not been converted into unsupported facts; any diagram-dependent learning surface needs its own evidence review.
The preaccept fact-check receipt is same-model review only; independent coverage and fact QA remain pending.
Unperioded crash statistics and trip-information service details remain currentness debt (verify PA-SHARING-CURRENTNESS).
Open-bed passenger restrictions and their cross-page exceptions are retained together as debt pending exact exception-scope verification (verify PA-SHARING-OPEN-BED).
Move Over injury penalties and the disabled-vehicle marking definition need exact current legal scope verification (verify PA-SHARING-MOVEOVER-DETAILS).
The absolute claim that truck turbulence only pushes vehicles apart is withheld pending contextual physics review (verify PA-SHARING-TURBULENCE).

corpus_stability.reason: The issuer currently links the PUB 95 (4-21) handbook; no frequent-rewrite evidence is asserted. Edition age and absent effective date remain accuracy debt in part A.

verification_debt.claim_text: Unperioded work-zone/rail/aggressive-driving crash statistics on58,59,64 and511PA service availability are not asserted as current stable facts.

Physical63 says open-bed occupancy bars speeds above35mph and children under18, then exceptions begin: farmer's child for farm work. Physical64 continues farm-employee child, licensed child hunter between camp/sites during season, and officially sanctioned parade participant during parade. Whole rule and exceptions retained as debt rather than guessing exception reach across the two prohibitions.

Physical63 has an ambiguous at-least-two-lamps/other-markers definition and overlapping general harm penalties90days/up-to1000dollars, protected-person serious injury6months/up-to5000, protected-person death1year/up-to10000. Exact current legal scope needs resolution before learner assertion.
Physical61 claims truck wind turbulence pushes vehicles apart and never pulls them together. This absolute directional claim is withheld pending contextual physics/source verification.
